title: Hardship Share Schedule — Belrose Promotional Financing Plans
content:
# Hardship Share Schedule — Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

The share of the payment the arrangement is built on that a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan bills while the arrangement runs is read from what stands on the plan and how long it has been billing.

| The plan at the handling date | The hardship share |
|---|---|
| An arrangement already stands in force on it | This desk's repeat-arrangement share of **75 percent** |
| No arrangement stands in force, **and** the plan began billing at least **twice** the term's minimum hardship tenure in whole calendar months before the handling date | This desk's long-standing share of **45 percent** |
| Any other case | The term's hardship share |

Twice is a multiple of **2** applied to the term's minimum hardship tenure.

## Figures by term

| Term | Minimum hardship tenure, whole months | Twice that tenure, whole months | The term's hardship share |
|---|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 6 | 12 | 50 percent |
| 12-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 6 | 12 | 50 percent |
| 18-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 9 | 18 | 50 percent |
| 24-Month Equal Payment Plan | 9 | 18 | 60 percent |
| 36-Month Equal Payment Plan | 12 | 24 | 60 percent |
| 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment Plan | 12 | 24 | 60 percent |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A plan on the 36-Month Equal Payment Plan already running on an arrangement: the share is 75 percent, whatever its tenure.
- The same plan with no arrangement in force, billing for 26 whole calendar months against a tenure of 12 and twice that of 24: the share is 45 percent.
- The same plan with no arrangement in force, billing for 15 whole calendar months: twice the tenure is not reached, so the share is that term's 60 percent.
- A plan on the 6-Month Deferred Interest Plan with no arrangement in force, billing for 13 whole calendar months against a tenure of 6 and twice that of 12: the share is 45 percent, rather than that term's 50 percent.
